about_the_game:
"The Little Witch’s Jump" is a cozy-looking but devilishly difficult "Precision platformer" for 2–4 players, where you can either team up to reach the top — or mess with each other just for fun.

Explore a variety of whimsical worlds, each with its own theme and unique mechanics that grow more challenging the higher you climb.

  

Gameplay :

– Play solo or with friends — your chaos, your choice!

The Little Witch’s Jump can be played alone for a pure test of patience and precision,
or together with 2–4 players in a hilarious co-op mode where teamwork quickly turns into friendly chaos.

When playing with friends, only one witch jumps at a time —
while others become playful fairies who can create or cancel platforms in real time.
Whether you help, troll, or betray, every jump becomes a story worth laughing about!

– Simple to play, hard to master.

Movement may look simple — walk, aim, charge, and jump, — controls your jump.
But every second of timing matters.
One perfect leap can feel magical… one mistake can send you right back to the start.
Patience, precision, and pure perseverance are your best friends.

– Every world feels new.

Each area brings its own atmosphere and unique mechanics to overcome.
From shifting platforms to magical surprises, no two challenges feel the same.
Your adaptability will be tested as much as your patience.

Game Highlights :

  • Single or Co-op Play — Enjoy a calm solo challenge or chaotic 2–4 player teamwork!

  • Turn-based Jumping System — Take turns as the witch while friends transform into fairies.

  • Fairy Platform Mechanic — Create or cancel platforms in real time to help (or mess with) your friends.

  • Precision Platforming — Walk, aim, and jump with care — every step and every leap matters.

  • Laugh, Fall, Repeat — Because every fail is funnier when shared with friends.

You might be wondering... “Does playing Co-op make it easier?”

Let me tell you this — it’s not what you think.

Try it yourself and you’ll find out what true chaos feels like. lol

Future Expansion :

– New maps, fresh twists, same chaotic magic!

The adventure doesn’t stop here — we’re working on brand new maps, mechanics, and features that expand on the existing themes of The Little Witch’s Jump.

Each update will bring new ways to challenge your timing, teamwork, and sense of humor.

Expect familiar worlds with unexpected surprises that keep every jump feeling fresh.

More laughter, more chaos — same little witch energy

The Little Witch’s Jump is our love letter to everyone who’s ever fallen, laughed, and tried again.
Whether you play solo or with friends, every jump tells your story — a mix of frustration, joy, and a little bit of magic.

We’re still growing, still adding, and still laughing with every update.
Thank you for supporting our little witch’s journey — and remember…
falling isn’t failure, it’s part of the fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 520 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated Sound Card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard or Controller required for Co-op play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or Dedicated Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard or Controller required for Co-op play.

short_description: A charming yet punishing platformer where every jump shapes your journey. Guide a little witch through ever-changing worlds — fall, learn, and rise again across realms of wonder and challenge.
